assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: An explicit non-modifying review workflow that covers security, reliability, maintainability, prioritized findings, remediation, and approval checks.
assessments.rationale: It can delegate PR review work, but the source supplies only general CLI orchestration rather than the requested end-to-end review/report method.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A workflow for reviewing the proposed change and its configuration, then producing prioritized security, reliability, and maintainability findings.
assessments.rationale: It is a general MCP-server access hub and provides no review or findings-report procedure.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A non-modifying review workflow and prioritized remediation report for a proposed change and configuration.
assessments.rationale: It is for building Ionic applications, not assessing an existing proposed change or configuration.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A workflow for security, reliability, and maintainability review of a proposed change and its configuration.
assessments.rationale: It is limited to bulk-expression GSVA or ssGSEA analysis and heatmap generation, outside the requested review task.
It supports non-interactive review prompts and PR review, so it can inspect the proposed change and supporting configuration without editing and return the requested findings and recommendations.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A workflow that performs the requested initial proposed-change review and produces its findings report without requiring a pre-existing hack-review report.
assessments.rationale: It consumes an existing hack-review report and is oriented to resolving its findings, not conducting the requested review.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: Coverage of reliability and maintainability for the whole proposed change and its supporting configuration, beyond third-party dependency risk.
assessments.rationale: Its findings-report format and security focus are useful, but its procedure is restricted to dependency and supply-chain risk rather than the full requested review.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: An explicit non-modifying review procedure that covers security, reliability, maintainability, prioritized remediation, and pre-approval checks.
assessments.rationale: It can delegate PR review and report risks, but the source provides generic agent orchestration rather than the requested complete review framework.
